_provenance: Rung 6 — shelter geometry. The form of the habitat emerges from constraints.
name: shelter_form
mirror_wall: Shelter must communicate safety through form alone. A box with a trigger fails the Mirror.
input: rung 5: trigger radius defines the minimum interior volume
walls: Must have an identifiable entrance from any approach angle
Must enclose a volume the player can stand inside (>= 300x300x200 units)
Must be visibly distinct from natural terrain at 100 units
Must be buildable from available materials (no floating geometry)

output.format: parametric geometry genome (height, radius, curvature, entrance width)
